This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.62/2024 dated 20.01.2024 registered at Police Station Banda District Sagar (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(3),
376(2)(n) of IPC and Section 3 r/w 4, 5 (ka) (L)/6 of POCSO Act, 2012.
Learned counsel for applicant has submitted that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the crime in question.
The applicant is in 2 MCRC-21755-2024 custody since 10.03.2024 and trial will take considerable time to conclude.
He further submits that applicant is permanent resident of district and there is no likelihood of his absconding from the clutches of law or tampering with prosecution evidence.

He also submits that the applicant is ready to furnish Dharmendra Paal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190838574/
1 adequate surety and shall abide by all the directions and conditions which may be imposed by this Court.

sentences.text: Upon these grounds, the applicant may be released on bail.
Learned counsel for the State has opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case-diary.
In this case, the prosecutrix was aged about 16 years 7 months old at the time of incident and she visited many places alongwith the applicant.
The State has opposed the bail application on the basis of DNA report, which is positive in nature.

Taking into consideration the overall facts and circumstances of the case and without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court deems it fit to release the applicant on bail, therefore, this bail application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of the trial.

It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
Accordingly, this M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
